result:
I’d make empathy automatic—not optional, not selective, but something humans can’t shut off when they look at another person.

If people truly felt, even for a moment, the consequences of their actions on others—war, cruelty, indifference, exploitation—it would become much harder to justify harm at scale. Everything else would be easier to fix from there.
